summary: Fixed the Overview's 7-day views so they can never exceed all-time views (YouTube removing invalid views made them), and wrote 5 video verdicts and The Why Atlas's first channel review. The data audit was 20 hours old, so the dashboard-vs-YouTube check was skipped again.
why: The last data audit (23 Nov) showed How Tech Works at 3,190 views in 7 days against 3,187 all time: the 7 days kept Analytics' 118 views for a Short YouTube now counts at 114. Fixed per video with a test that fails on the old code.
